column2:

view -0.1, 1.15, -0.1, 1.1
F = graph(x^2, x, 0, 1) thick color 2
Av0 = segment(0/5, 0/5 + 1/25*i) color 1
Av1 = segment(1/5, 1/5 + 4/25*i) color 1
Av2 = segment(2/5, 2/5 + 9/25*i) color 1

Av4 = segment(4/5, 4/5 + 25/25*i) color 1
Av5 = segment(5/5, 5/5 + 25/25*i) color 1
At1 = segment(0/5 + 1/25*i, 1/5 + 1/25*i) color 1
At2 = segment(1/5 + 4/25*i, 2/5 + 4/25*i) color 1
At3 = segment(2/5 + 9/25*i, 3/5 + 9/25*i) color 1
At4 = segment(3/5 + 16/25*i, 4/5 + 16/25*i) color 1
At5 = segment(4/5 + 25/25*i, 5/5 + 25/25*i) color 1
Bv0 = segment(0/10, 0/10 + 1/100*i) color 4
Bv1 = segment(1/10, 1/10 + 4/100*i) color 4
Bv2 = segment(2/10, 2/10 + 9/100*i) color 4
Bv3 = segment(3/10, 3/10 + 16/100*i) color 4
Bv4 = segment(4/10, 4/10 + 25/100*i) color 4
Bv5 = segment(5/10, 5/10 + 36/100*i) color 4
Bv6 = segment(6/10, 6/10 + 49/100*i) color 4
Bv7 = segment(7/10, 7/10 + 64/100*i) color 4
Bv8 = segment(8/10, 8/10 + 81/100*i) color 4
Bv9 = segment(9/10, 9/10 + 100/100*i) color 4
Bv10 = segment(10/10, 10/10 + 100/100*i) color 4
Bt1 = segment(0/10 + 1/100*i, 1/10 + 1/100*i) color 4
Bt2 = segment(1/10 + 4/100*i, 2/10 + 4/100*i) color 4
Bt3 = segment(2/10 + 9/100*i, 3/10 + 9/100*i) color 4
Bt4 = segment(3/10 + 16/100*i, 4/10 + 16/100*i) color 4
Bt5 = segment(4/10 + 25/100*i, 5/10 + 25/100*i) color 4

> show F | The curve $y = x^2$ from $0$ to $1$.
> show Av0, Av1, Av2, Av3, Av4, Av5, At1, At2, At3, At4, At5 | Five strips of width $\frac15$; the $k$-th rectangle is $(k/5)^2$ tall. Each one pokes above the curve, so together they are too big.
> hide Av0, Av1, Av2, Av3, Av4, Av5, At1, At2, At3, At4, At5; show Bv0, Bv1, Bv2, Bv3, Bv4, Bv5, Bv6, Bv7, Bv8, Bv9, Bv10, Bt1, Bt2, Bt3, Bt4, Bt5, Bt6, Bt7, Bt8, Bt9, Bt10 | Ten strips: the parts above the curve are thinner, and the total is closer.
let R = sum((k/n)^2 / n, k, 1, n)

clock X from 0.6 to 1.5
view -0.1, 1.6, -0.15, 2.4
F = graph(x^2, x, 0, 1.5) color 2
LF = label(0.6 + 1.6*i, "f(x) = x^2") color 2
E = segment(X, X + i*X^2) color 2
A = graph(x^3/3, x, 0, X) thick color 1
P = point(X + i*X^3/3) color 1
LA = label(P, "A(x)") color 1
S1 = segment(X + 0.1, X + 0.1 + i*X^2) color 3
S2 = segment(X + i*X^2, X + 0.1 + i*X^2) color 3
> show F, LF, E | The curve $y = x^2$, and the region under it from $0$ to $x$.
> show A, P, LA; play X to 1.5 in 5s | Move $x$ and plot the area so far, $A(x)$, as it grows.
> show S1, S2; play X to 1 in 3s | Push $x$ on by $dx$: the area gains a thin strip, of height $f(x)$ and width $dx$. So $dA \approx f(x)\,dx$: the slope of $A$ is $f$.
